Tap Start to turn it on

Setup (once per Wi-Fi network)
1. Tap Start.
2. Settings → Wi-Fi → tap the gear next to your network.
3. Proxy → Manual. Hostname: 127.0.0.1, Port: 8080. Save.

Daily use
Turn it on and off from the app, the notification or the Quick Settings tile (pull down the notification panel, tap the pencil and add “SpoofDPI+”).

No internet on Wi-Fi?
SpoofDPI+ is stopped while the Wi-Fi proxy is still set. Tap Start, or set Proxy back to None in Wi-Fi settings.

The app gets closed in the background
Tap “Allow background running” so battery saving does not stop it.

Limitations
• Wi-Fi only: Android does not let apps set a proxy for mobile data without a VPN or root.
• Some apps and games ignore the system proxy.
• Discord voice uses UDP and does not go through the proxy.

SpoofDPI+ bypasses DPI (Deep Packet Inspection) blocks on Android.

It is not a VPN. A small proxy runs on your phone (127.0.0.1:8080). Your traffic does not go to any other server and your speed stays the same.

How it works
• DNS is resolved with DNS-over-HTTPS (1.1.1.1), so fake ISP DNS answers are skipped.
• The first packet of an HTTPS connection (TLS ClientHello) contains the site name in plain text. SpoofDPI+ sends its first 40 bytes as separate tiny packets, and the DPI stops looking before it reaches the site name.

Based on the method of SpoofDPI, inspired by SplitWire-Turkey.

For freedom of access to information. Use at your own responsibility.
